integrity: All endpoint formulas are derived from independently reconstructed entropy expansions and the source channel-to-temperature map. Numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Information-theoretic capacity boundaries only; no claim that a particular efficient decoder attains the Holevo ceiling for arbitrary code families, and no converse outside the uniformly coupled commuting QD-HDQI reduction.
title: Endpoint laws for the Shannon–Holevo temperature gap in quantum-decoded Gibbs preparation
